name: Buoyancy Absence Regime Analysis
description: Evaluates whether buoyant natural convection is suppressed (Grashof/Richardson scaling near 0g) by inspecting vertical elongation, plume rise absence, and isotropic flame standoff.
prerequisites: Segmented flame geometry or gravity acceleration metadata (g <= 0.01g)

name: Diffusion-Dominated Transport Screening
description: Screens for molecular diffusion-controlled oxidizer and product transport characteristic of quiescent microgravity droplet and solid-fuel flames (d-squared law and standoff scaling).
prerequisites: Flame radius/area history or oxidizer concentration and ambient pressure metadata

name: Marangoni Thermocapillary Flow Assessment
description: Assesses surface-tension-driven thermocapillary convection along liquid fuel droplets, molten polymer layers (e.g., PMMA melt pool), or bubble interfaces in low gravity.
prerequisites: Liquid/melt interface imagery, thermal gradient, or surface-tension metadata

name: Spherical Flame Symmetry Evaluation
description: Quantifies proximity to an ideal spherical diffusion flame envelope in microgravity using roundness, radial radius variance, and multi-axis mirror IoU.
prerequisites: Visible or chemiluminescent flame image with resolvable outer boundary

name: Cool-Flame & Low-Temperature Oxidation Screening
description: Screens for two-stage ignition and radiative extinction transition to low-temperature (~500-800 K) cool-flame burning observed in NASA FLEX/FLEX-2 alkane droplet experiments.
prerequisites: Low-luminosity UV/formaldehyde emission, radiometer drop, or alkane fuel context

name: Cross-Gravity Regime Comparison
description: Compares flame geometry, standoff distance, and spread rate across 0g, partial gravity, and 1g conditions to isolate buoyant versus diffusive effects.
prerequisites: Gravity level metadata or multi-condition experimental dataset

name: Radiative & Low-Strain Quenching Limit Analysis
description: Evaluates radiative heat-loss quenching at ultra-low convective strain rates where microgravity flames extinguish due to optically thin soot/gas radiation.
prerequisites: Forced airflow velocity, oxygen mole fraction, or radiometer time series

name: Multi-Threshold Flame Segmentation
description: Extracts the contiguous luminous reaction zone mask from visible or multispectral frames using luminance-chromaticity weighting and adaptive Otsu thresholding.
prerequisites: 2D image or video frame with distinguishable flame region

name: Bilateral (Left-Right) Symmetry Analysis
description: Computes lateral reflectional symmetry across the vertical centroid axis to detect cross-flow distortion, burner tilt, or asymmetric acoustic perturbation.
prerequisites: Segmented flame mask and intensity crop

name: Top-Bottom (Axial) Symmetry Analysis
description: Measures vertical reflectional symmetry across the horizontal centroid plane; high values indicate 0g spherical diffusion while low values indicate buoyant plume elongation or forced flow.
prerequisites: Segmented flame mask

name: Rotational & Radial Symmetry Profiling
description: Evaluates 90-degree and 180-degree rotational invariance around the flame centroid to quantify azimuthal uniformity in droplet and spherical burner flames.
prerequisites: Segmented flame mask

name: Mirror Intersection-over-Union (IoU)
description: Calculates Jaccard overlap between the segmented flame mask and its horizontal/vertical reflections aligned at the centroid.
prerequisites: Binary flame segmentation mask

name: Hull Convexity & Solidity Measurement
description: Computes area solidity (area / convex hull area) and perimeter convexity (hull perimeter / contour perimeter) to detect cellular instabilities, soot tails, or cusping.
prerequisites: Segmented flame contour

name: Box-Counting Fractal Dimension
description: Estimates the Minkowski-Bouligand box-counting dimension of the flame front boundary across dyadic grid scales to characterize wrinkling and diffusive-thermal instability.
prerequisites: flame boundary edge map with sufficient pixel resolution

name: Boundary Roughness & Perimeter Tortuosity
description: Quantifies high-frequency contour corrugation and normalized perimeter tortuosity relative to an equivalent-area circle and convex hull.
prerequisites: Segmented flame contour

name: Intensity-Weighted Centroid & Offset Features
description: Computes both geometric and luminance-weighted centroids and measures displacement between peak reaction zone emission and outer flame envelope center.
prerequisites: Grayscale/color flame image and segmentation mask

name: Geometric Flame Morphology Classification
description: Classifies the observed flame envelope into morphological archetypes (spherical, hemispherical/cap, ellipsoidal, elongated teardrop, fragmented/cellular) from shape descriptors.
prerequisites: Computed aspect ratio, symmetry, and solidity descriptors

name: Frame-to-Frame Area & Intensity Variation
description: Tracks temporal evolution of flame projected area and integrated luminosity across video frames or time-series tables to quantify growth, steady burning, or decay.
prerequisites: Multi-frame video sequence or time-resolved area/luminosity table

name: Temporal Symmetry Variance
description: Computes variance and standard deviation of bilateral and axial symmetry indices over time to detect onset of oscillatory instability or g-jitter perturbation.
prerequisites: Multi-frame flame video

name: Centroid Jitter & Trajectory Stability
description: Measures root-mean-square frame-to-frame centroid displacement and drift velocity to distinguish tethered burner flames from drifting droplet or acoustic-driven flames.
prerequisites: Time-ordered video frames or centroid coordinate table

name: Flame Flicker Frequency & Spectral Oscillation
description: Applies Fourier spectral analysis to frame-wise luminosity and area fluctuations to identify dominant oscillation frequencies (e.g., 10-15 Hz buoyant flicker vs low-frequency 0g pulsations).
prerequisites: Video with known frame rate or evenly sampled luminosity time series

name: Extinction & Quenching Event Screening
description: Detects rapid collapse of luminous flame area or heat-release signal toward background baseline indicative of diffusive, radiative, or blowoff extinction.
prerequisites: Temporal sequence covering late-stage burn or extinction boundary table

name: Reignition & Hot-Spot Recovery Screening
description: Screens for post-extinction luminosity resurgence or secondary ignition following cool-flame transition or oxygen/airflow step changes.
prerequisites: Continuous temporal recording across quenching and recovery window

name: Schlieren Density-Gradient Interpretation
description: Analyzes first-derivative refractive-index gradients from Schlieren optics to visualize thermal plumes, acoustic waves, and hot-gas envelopes around low-luminosity flames.
prerequisites: Collimated Schlieren optical setup imagery and knife-edge orientation metadata

name: Shadowgraph Refractive-Index Field Screening
description: Evaluates Laplacian refractive-index variations (second spatial derivative of density) in shadowgraph imagery of preheat zones and convective boundaries.
prerequisites: Calibrated shadowgraph optical path imagery

name: Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) Flow Reconstruction
description: Reconstructs 2D/3D velocity vectors and vorticity fields from laser-sheet-illuminated tracer particle image pairs.
prerequisites: Seeded tracer particle image pairs, inter-frame laser pulse delay dt, spatial calibration, and cross-correlation PIV solver

name: Infrared Thermography Field Analysis
description: Examines spatial thermal distributions and pyrolysis front propagation in solid fuel and droplet combustion.
prerequisites: Infrared camera data, spectral band metadata, and radiometric lookup

name: Calibrated FLIR Radiometric Temperature Estimation
description: Converts calibrated long-wave or mid-wave IR radiometric counts into surface and gas-phase temperature maps (K) accounting for surface emissivity and window transmission.
prerequisites: Radiometric FLIR array, surface emissivity, window transmittance, and blackbody calibration

name: Coupled Temperature & Flow-Field Interpretation
description: Synthesizes thermocouple/radiometer profiles with forced-convection velocity data to evaluate Peclet and Damkohler regime behavior.
prerequisites: Synchronized temperature/heat-flux and flow-velocity measurements

name: Laser-Induced Fluorescence (LIF) Radical Mapping
description: Maps excited combustion intermediates (OH*, CH*, formaldehyde CH2O) via planar laser-induced fluorescence to locate primary reaction and cool-flame zones.
prerequisites: Tuned excitation laser sheet, narrowband ICCD filter metadata, and collisional quenching correction

name: Fourier-Transform Infrared (FTIR) Gas Analysis
description: Identifies infrared absorption bands of combustion products (CO2, CO, H2O, unburned hydrocarbons, pyrolysis gases) from wavenumber spectra.
prerequisites: Calibrated wavenumber axis (cm^-1), absorbance/transmittance spectrum, and HITRAN/reference database

name: Spontaneous & Coherent Raman Thermometry/Species
description: Extracts major species mole fractions (N2, O2, fuel) and rotational/vibrational gas temperatures from Stokes/anti-Stokes Raman scattering.
prerequisites: Raman shift spectrum, laser wavelength calibration, and spectral line-shape solver

name: Spectral Peak & Baseline Processing
description: Performs baseline estimation, normalization, SNR calculation, and prominent peak detection on uploaded 1D wavelength or wavenumber spectral tables.
prerequisites: Tabular or JSON spectrum with wavelength/wavenumber and intensity columns

name: Combustion Radical & Species Interpretation
description: Associates observed spectral bands or gas analyzer tables (OH ~308 nm, CH ~431 nm, C2 Swan bands ~516 nm, CO2 4.3 um) with reaction zone chemistry.
prerequisites: Calibrated wavelength/wavenumber peaks or gas analyzer concentration table

name: CO & Soot Precursor Formation Screening
description: Screens for yellow/orange soot incandescence versus blue chemiluminescence in imagery and CO/CO2 yield ratios in tabular cabin gas logs.
prerequisites: Color flame imagery or CO/soot concentration measurements

name: Reduced & Detailed Chemical Kinetics Context
description: Links experimental extinction and ignition trends to chemical kinetic pathways (chain branching vs chain termination and third-body reactions).
prerequisites: Detailed kinetic mechanism solver (e.g., Cantera/CHEMKIN) and reaction rate inputs

name: Drop Tower Short-Duration 0g Context
description: Contextualizes evidence against 2.2-second and 5.2-second NASA Glenn drop-tower constraints (ultra-low g-jitter ~10^-5 g, limited burn duration for thick solids).
prerequisites: Platform metadata or experiment duration <= 6 seconds

name: Parabolic Flight Gravity-Jitter Context
description: Accounts for 20-second parabolic aircraft trajectories and residual g-jitter (~0.01-0.02g) that can induce buoyant drift or flame oscillation.
prerequisites: Parabolic flight metadata or accelerometer trace

name: Sounding Rocket Extended Microgravity Context
description: Contextualizes intermediate-duration (3-15 minute) suborbital sounding rocket combustion experiments bridging drop towers and orbital facilities.
prerequisites: Suborbital flight metadata or experiment documentation

name: ISS Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR / SoFIE / FLEX) Context
description: Maps experimental conditions to International Space Station facilities (CIR, MDCA, FEANICS, MSG/BASS-II, SoFIE) with long-duration steady microgravity.
prerequisites: ISS facility/investigation metadata or PSI accession

name: Orbital Capsule & Spacecraft Cabin Experiment Context
description: Evaluates large-scale autonomous spacecraft fire experiments (such as NASA Saffire on Cygnus vehicles) where enclosure pressure rise and oxygen depletion occur.
prerequisites: Enclosure volume, cabin pressure/oxygen evolution, or Saffire PSI metadata

name: Microgravity (0g) Baseline Characterization
description: Establishes the 0g pure-diffusion or low-velocity forced-flow baseline where buoyant velocity scale u_b = (g * beta * dT * L)^(1/2) vanishes.
prerequisites: 0g experimental evidence or PSI baseline record

name: Terrestrial (1g) Buoyant Reference Comparison
description: Compares low-gravity observations against normal 1g upward/downward flame spread and buoyant plume entrainment (~30-50 cm/s induced flow).
prerequisites: 1g reference metrics or gravity comparison table

name: Lunar Gravity (0.17g) Flammability & Spread Context
description: Assesses flame behavior in lunar partial gravity (0.17g), where weak buoyant flow (~10-18 cm/s) replenishes oxygen while radiative heat loss remains reduced relative to 1g.
prerequisites: Gravity metadata, oxygen/pressure atmosphere context (e.g., Artemis exploration atmosphere 34% O2 / 56.5 kPa), or partial-g dataset

name: Martian Gravity (0.38g) Mixed-Convection Context
description: Evaluates mixed-convection combustion in Martian surface habitat gravity (0.38g), balancing moderate buoyant entrainment (~20-26 cm/s) with habitat ventilation flows.
prerequisites: Gravity metadata, habitat pressure/O2 parameters, or partial-gravity table

name: Partial-Gravity Froude/Grashof Scaling Comparison
description: Computes dimensionless buoyant velocity proxy and Grashof/Reynolds regime indicators across 0g, 0.17g (Moon), 0.38g (Mars), and 1g (Earth).
prerequisites: Gravity acceleration g, characteristic length scale, or flow velocity

name: CNN / ResNet Flame Regime Classification
description: Deep convolutional feature classification of flame regimes (sooting vs non-sooting, radiative quenching vs stable burning) using calibrated neural weights.
prerequisites: Pretrained and domain-validated ResNet/CNN model weights on NASA PSI imagery

name: Differentiable Symmetry Loss & Mirror IoU Metric
description: Computes continuous soft-mask reflectional symmetry loss (1 - SoftIoU) and intensity L1 reflection residual for automated morphological ranking.
prerequisites: Normalized intensity map and segmented probability/binary mask

name: Temporal Sequence ML Anomaly Detection
description: Identifies anomalous transitions (sudden flare-up, acoustic lock-in, or impending extinction) in multi-frame descriptor trajectories using sequence z-score and change-point screening.
prerequisites: Multi-frame video sequence or multi-row time series (>= 8 samples)

name: Spectral & Multimodal Embedding Retrieval
description: Matches multimodal descriptor vectors and spectral/tabular signatures against verified NASA PSI experiment records via normalized feature similarity.
prerequisites: Extracted descriptor vector and populated NASA PSI SQLite catalogue

name: Technique-Bounded LLM Evidence Synthesis
description: Constrains Gemini or OpenAI reasoning strictly to whitelisted technique IDs, computed local descriptors, and verified NASA PSI accessions with schema validation.
prerequisites: Selected technique whitelist and extracted evidence context

name: Cross-Experiment NASA PSI Similarity Comparison
description: Ranks candidate NASA PSI investigations (e.g., PSI-98, PSI-107, PSI-25, PSI-112, PSI-64) against current evidence across fuel, gravity, platform, diagnostics, and geometry.
prerequisites: NASA PSI SQLite catalogue and extracted evidence metadata/descriptors

name: Multi-Criteria Evidence & Hazard Ranking
description: Computes weighted priority scores combining flammability/spread severity, evidence completeness, and lunar/Martian mission relevance with confidence grades.
prerequisites: Computed descriptors or matched NASA PSI investigation parameters

name: Combustion Anomaly & Instability Screening
description: Flags safety-critical combustion behaviors such as invisible cool-flame persistence, low-velocity ventilation blowoff/reignition, or molten polymer droplet ejection.
prerequisites: Extracted geometry, temporal, or tabular combustion descriptors

name: Spacecraft Material Flammability Risk Screening
description: Evaluates solid and liquid material hazards (PMMA, cotton/Nomex fabrics, heptane/methanol fuels) under elevated-oxygen exploration atmospheres and low-velocity ventilation.
prerequisites: Material/fuel identifier and oxygen/pressure conditions

name: Evidence-Linked Crew Safety & Suppression Insights
description: Formulates traceable spacecraft fire detection (UV/IR/CO/smoke) and suppression (ventilation shutoff, N2/CO2/fine water mist) insights linked directly to measured descriptors and PSI records.
prerequisites: Computed descriptors and verified PSI candidate references

name: Measurement Uncertainty & Follow-Up Experiment Gap Analysis
description: Identifies missing calibrations (scale bar, radiometric emissivity, frame rate, oxygen sensor logs) and recommends specific follow-up NASA PSI datasets or partial-gravity tests.
prerequisites: Evidence inventory and technique execution-state audit
